Fournir le service que tu demandes en cr: Providing the service you ask for when you create your account (performance of a contract): storing and syncing your content, sharing it in the groups you join, securing your account.
Garder le service sûr et fiable (intérêt: Keeping the service safe and reliable (legitimate interest): anti-abuse limits, bot checks at sign-up and login, error logs, handling reports.
Améliorer Kompaly (intérêt légitime) : l: Improving Kompaly (legitimate interest): reading the feedback and fixing the bugs you send us, and counting visits anonymously (see “Storage on your device”).
Quand tu poses une question à Kompaly en: When you ask Kompaly a question in Smart mode, your message and whatever is needed to answer it (for example the text of a file you ask it to read) are sent to the AI provider: Groq, Inc. (United States). Groq keeps neither your messages nor the answers (“zero data retention” option turned on).
Ce transfert hors de l’Union européenne: This transfer outside the European Union is covered by the European Commission’s standard contractual clauses, included in Groq’s data processing agreement. Kompaly’s Simple mode works without sending anything.
N’envoie pas à Kompaly d’informations se: Don’t send Kompaly sensitive information (health, other people’s data…).
Enregistrer un cours ou une réunion: Recording a lecture or a meeting
Quand tu enregistres un cours, une réuni: When you record a lecture, a meeting or anything else, the audio (from your mic, or from the computer when you share a tab or your screen) is cut into chunks of about twenty seconds, sent one by one to Groq to be turned into text (along with the title, your keywords and the end of the previous passage, to recognise words better), then deleted: neither Kompaly nor Groq keeps the audio. Moments when nobody is speaking are not sent.
Avec le micro, le navigateur peut aussi: With the mic, the browser can also write the words live using its own speech recognition (Google’s in Chrome, Apple’s in Safari), under that browser’s rules.
Le texte est ensuite rédigé (cours, comp: The text is then written up (lecture notes, minutes, revision sheet, summary, exam or questions) by the AI provider named above, and the documents are filed in your Drive. The same provider makes a revision sheet or an exam from a document in your Drive when you ask (right-click on the file): the document’s text is then sent to it. During recording, the transcript is kept on your device so nothing is lost if the page closes.
Si tu actives « Alertes aussi sur mon té: If you turn on “Alerts on my phone too”, the keyword heard and the sentence it was said in are sent to your other devices as a notification (see “Who has access”).
Enregistrer quelqu’un demande son accord: Recording someone requires their consent: ask your teacher, your colleagues or the people present before you start.
Personne d’autre que toi pour ton espace: No one but you for your personal space. Members of a group see what is shared in that group.
L’administrateur du site (l’éditeur) voi: The site administrator (the publisher) sees the list of accounts in order to run the service: first name, email, sign-up and last login dates, whether two-factor authentication is on, number of notes, events and files, space used, names of the categories you create (not your events). They also read “Feedback or bug” messages and reports, with the copy of the reported content. Never the rest of the content of your notes, files or events.
Nos sous-traitants techniques les traite: Our technical processors handle them only to run the service: Render (site hosting, servers in Frankfurt, Germany), Supabase (accounts, data and files, servers in Ireland), Resend (sending account emails: confirmation, forgotten password; receives your email address, servers in Ireland), Cloudflare (Turnstile bot check at sign-up and login: receives your IP address and information about your browser for the duration of the check, with no ad tracking; and anonymous audience measurement; data processing agreement and standard contractual clauses) and Groq (the AI provider named above, and transcription of recording audio, with no retention).
Plusieurs de ces prestataires sont des s: Several of these providers are companies based outside the European Union (United States, Singapore). Even when their servers are in Europe, their data processing agreements include the European Commission’s standard contractual clauses or the EU–US Data Privacy Framework.
Si tu te connectes avec Google ou Apple,: If you log in with Google or Apple, that service knows you use Kompaly, under its own privacy policy.
Les notifications passent par le service: Notifications go through the notification service of your browser or phone (Google for Chrome and Android, Apple for Safari and iPhone, Mozilla for Firefox, Microsoft for Edge): the message is end-to-end encrypted, that service can’t read it and only passes it on to your device.
Tant que ton compte existe. Ce que tu me: For as long as your account exists. Anything you move to the Trash is permanently deleted after 30 days.
« Supprimer définitivement mon compte »: “Delete my account permanently” (Profile › Account) immediately erases your account, your content and your online files. A reminder is erased from our servers one week after it is sent; a device stops receiving them as soon as you turn off notifications, log out without “Stay logged in” or remove it. Error logs are kept for up to 12 months, “Feedback or bug” messages and reports for up to 2 years (without your name or email once your account is deleted).
Kompaly garde une copie de tes données d: Kompaly keeps a copy of your data in your browser so it runs fast and offline, and so you stay logged in. This is only storage needed for the service: no advertising or audience measurement cookies, so no consent banner.
Pour savoir combien de personnes utilise: To know how many people use Kompaly and whether pages load quickly, we count visits with Cloudflare Web Analytics: the page viewed, the site you came from, your country, the type of device and browser, the loading time. No cookies, nothing saved on your device and no identifier: a visit can’t be linked to you or to your later visits, and nothing is used for advertising.
Pour que la recherche trouve les mots à: So that search finds words inside your PDF, Word and PowerPoint files, Kompaly reads their text in your browser and keeps it on your device. This text is sent to no one; it is erased when you log out, along with the copy of your data, when “Stay logged in” is not ticked.
Avec « Rester connecté » (case de la pag: With “Stay logged in” (a box on the login page), your account stays listed on this device’s login page (first name, email and session) so you can open it in one click, even after logging out; after 14 days without opening it, your password is asked for again. “Remove from this device” (the cross next to the account) erases it and ends its session. Without this box, logging out erases the copy and the session.
Tu peux accéder à tes données, les corri: You can access your data, correct it, export it (Profile › Data › Export) and delete it (Profile › Account). You can also object to processing or ask for it to be restricted by writing to {email}.
Si tu estimes que tes droits ne sont pas: If you think your rights are not being respected, you can complain to the CNIL (cnil.fr).

Kompaly est ouvert dès 15 ans. Avant 15: Kompaly is open from age 15. Under 15, you need the consent of a parent or legal guardian to create an account.
Une vérification anti-robot peut être de: A bot check may be required at sign-up and login.
Tu es responsable de ton mot de passe et: You are responsible for your password and, if you turn it on, for your two-factor authentication phone. Keep your backup key somewhere safe: without it, a lost phone can lock you out of your account.
Si tu te connectes avec Google, Apple, F: If you log in with Google, Apple, Face ID or your fingerprint, the security of your Kompaly account also depends on that account or device: protect them like your password.
Limites actuelles : 50 Mo par fichier, 1: Current limits: 50 MB per file, 1 GB of space per account, a limited number of questions per day to Kompaly in Smart mode and of transcribed recording minutes per day.
Déposer ou partager des contenus illégau: Uploading or sharing content that is illegal, hateful or violent, or that infringes the rights of others (copyright, privacy).
Tenter de contourner la sécurité, les li: Trying to get around security or limits, or to access other users’ data; using the service in an automated or abusive way.
Nous pouvons supprimer un contenu signal: We may remove content reported as unlawful and suspend an account that breaks these rules. To report content in a group: the “Report” button (the flag) next to that content, or an email to {email}. Every report is reviewed, and the content is removed if it breaks these rules.
Kompaly est une intelligence artificiell: Kompaly is an artificial intelligence: he can get things wrong. Check what he tells you, especially for your lessons, your important dates and your deadlines. He always asks you to confirm before deleting anything.
Les documents écrits à partir d’un enreg: Documents written from a recording or a file (lecture notes, minutes, revision sheet, summary, exam) are drafted by AI from an automatic transcript: read them over before using them.
Nous faisons le maximum pour que le serv: We do our best to keep the service available and your data protected, but can’t guarantee it 100%. Regularly export a backup of what matters to you.
Tu peux supprimer ton compte à tout mome: You can delete your account at any time. If these terms change significantly, you’ll be told in the app.
